title: pilosella tardiuscula
intro: Pilosella tardiuscula, commonly known as Yellow Salsify or Western Buttercup, is a flowering plant species in the dandelion family (Asteraceae). This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and alleviating symptoms of anxiety and insomnia. The therapeutic actions of Pilosella tardiuscula include its sedative, anti-inflammatory, and spasmolytic properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as sesquiterpene lactones and flavonoids. The bioactive constituents of Pilosella tardiuscula have been shown to exhibit antioxidant and anti-cancer properties, making it a subject of interest in modern herbal medicine.
